swap-local-global/cant-convert-stage: The stage can't have variables for this sprite only.

swap-local-global/cant-convert-used-else: Can't convert because it's used by another sprite: {sprite}
debugger/compiler-warning: The debugger works best when the compiler is disabled.
layer-manager/cancelled: Layer move cancelled because the project or target changed.
linter/rule-warp-wait: Possible waits in custom blocks running without screen refresh
linter/coverage: Checks sprite, costume and sound selections, and possible behavior problems. Checks do not run the project; values determined during a run may be unknown.
linter/failed: Checks could not finish. Try checking again.
linter/unavailable: Could not jump to this location. Checking again.
linter/no-rules: Enable a check rule to see results.
linter/empty: No issues found by the enabled checks. This does not guarantee the project is free of problems.
linter/warp-wait: Custom block "{procedure}" contains an operation that may wait
linter/unused-data: {type, select, list {List} other {Variable}} "{name}" is not used by any blocks
linter/reason-missing-target: There is no sprite named "{name}" in this project. Check the spelling or select a sprite again.
linter/reason-warp-wait: This custom block runs without screen refresh, but this operation or a called custom block may wait.
linter/reason-unused-data: No blocks use this item, and it is not displayed on the stage. Check whether you want to keep it before deleting it.
linter/missing-costume: Costume or backdrop "{name}" cannot be resolved
linter/reason-missing-costume: No costume or backdrop matches this selection. Check the sprite's costumes or the stage's backdrops, then select one again.
linter/reason-missing-sound: No sound matches this selection. Check the Sounds tab for this sprite or stage, then select a sound again.
linter/invalid-data: Cannot use the selected variable or list "{name}"
linter/reason-invalid-data: The selected item may have been deleted, belong to another sprite, or be the wrong kind of data. Select it again in the block menu; creating another item with the same name may not restore the connection.
linter/reason-invalid-property: The selected sprite or stage has no property or local variable named "{name}". Check the target and select what to read again.
linter/duplicate-procedure: Custom block "{name}" is defined more than once
linter/invalid-procedure: Custom block definition or call is inconsistent
linter/reason-invalid-procedure: Check the definition and its inputs, and make sure the call block matches them.
linter/invalid-argument: Custom block parameter or return is inconsistent
linter/reason-invalid-argument: Check that this input belongs to the current custom block and whether its definition returns a value.
linter/invalid-component: The selected component does not support this operation or event
linter/reason-invalid-component: The target sprite may be missing, may not be a component, or may not support this property or event. Check the target and component type.
linter/reason-invalid-graph: Connections between blocks are damaged. Try undoing the recent edit or adding these blocks again.
linter/broadcast-flow: Broadcast "{name}" has no matching sender or receiver
linter/reason-broadcast-flow: No matching broadcast or "when I receive" block was found. Plugins or messages determined during a run may still trigger the event.
linter/unused-procedure: No other scripts were found calling custom block "{name}"
linter/reason-unused-procedure: Calling itself, or a group of custom blocks calling one another, does not start them automatically. No call from outside this group was found; loose call blocks are also counted.
linter/write-only-data: "{name}" is changed but its contents are not used
linter/reason-write-only-data: Blocks change this item, but no blocks read its contents and it is not displayed on the stage. Check whether these changes are needed.
linter/constant-control: The condition has a fixed result, or the block is empty
linter/reason-constant-control: The condition or repeat count can be determined without running the project, or the control block has no blocks inside it.
linter/unreachable-code: The script will not reach this block
linter/reason-unreachable-code: An earlier block stops, returns, or loops forever, so the script will not continue here. You can still click this block to run it manually.
linter/rule-nonterminating-control: Constant waits or loops that cannot finish
linter/nonterminating-control: This condition cannot finish the wait or loop
linter/reason-nonterminating-control: The condition is constant. Ordinary forever loops and recursion are not flagged by this rule.
linter/rule-numeric-result: Calculations producing infinity or an invalid number
linter/reason-numeric-result: Infinity means an infinite value; NaN means no valid number was produced. Check for division by zero or unsuitable inputs. Scratch does not throw an error, but later calculations may give unexpected results.
linter/unused-resource: No use was found for costume, backdrop or sound "{name}"
linter/reason-unused-resource: No block uses this item, and it is not a current costume or a component costume. Items that may be selected by number or by a value determined during a run are retained. Check before deleting it.
linter/reason-invalid-procedure-definiti: The definition is missing its name or input information. Try editing or recreating the definition.
linter/reason-invalid-procedure-signatur: The custom block's input information is damaged: names, defaults or input connections do not match. Try editing the definition.
linter/reason-invalid-procedure-missing: This sprite has no matching definition, and no enabled addon provides this block. Add the definition or enable the corresponding addon.
linter/reason-invalid-procedure-paramete: This call's inputs do not match the definition. Add a fresh call block from the palette. Leaving an input empty to use its default is allowed.
linter/reason-invalid-procedure-duplicat: This sprite has multiple definitions with the same name and input pattern. A call cannot choose between them. Rename or merge them; different sprites can have definitions with the same name.
linter/reason-invalid-argument-return-ty: The call and definition disagree on whether the custom block returns a value.
linter/reason-invalid-argument-parameter: This custom block has no input with this name. Drag the input you need from its definition block.
linter/reason-invalid-argument-outside: This return block is not inside a custom block definition. Here it stops the current script.
linter/reason-invalid-graph-connection: A block connected here is missing. Try undoing the recent edit or reconnecting the blocks.
linter/reason-invalid-graph-cycle: Block connections lead back to themselves, forming a damaged connection. Try undoing or reconnecting them. A custom block calling itself is allowed.
linter/reason-broadcast-flow-sender: No block broadcasting "{name}" was found. Plugins or messages determined during a run may still trigger this event.
linter/reason-broadcast-flow-receiver: No "when I receive {name}" block was found. Check the message name or add a receiver.
linter/reason-constant-control-condition: This condition can be checked without running the project: it is {value, select, true {always true} other {always false}}. Check whether this is intentional.
linter/reason-constant-control-repeat: The repeat count rounds to 0 or less, so the blocks inside will never run. Check the count.
linter/reason-constant-control-empty: This control block has no blocks inside, and its inputs have no known additional effects. Check whether you left out any blocks.
linter/reason-nonterminating-control-con: With this condition, the wait or loop will not finish on its own. Check the condition; the stop button can still interrupt it.
linter/limit-dynamic-reference: Some sprite or resource selections are only known when the project runs.
linter/limit-dynamic-data: Some variables or lists may be used during a run and are not marked as unused.
linter/limit-dynamic-broadcast: Broadcast names may be determined at runtime.
linter/limit-expression-limit: Some calculations are too complex to check.
linter/limit-addon-block: Unknown addon blocks are not analyzed.
linter/incomplete: The project is too large or its blocks are too complex. This check did not finish.
linter/limit-dynamic-expression: Some conditions depend on runtime values.
linter/reason-invalid-graph-structure: This block is missing its type information and cannot be identified. Try undoing the recent edit or adding the block again.
linter/unused-data-partial: No known references to {type, select, list {list} other {variable}} "{name}"
linter/write-only-data-partial: Data "{name}" is written, with no known reads
linter/unused-procedure-partial: Custom block "{name}" has no known external calls
linter/reason-partial-reference: No matching use was found in the blocks that could be analyzed. Unknown blocks or addons may still use this item; check before deleting or changing it.
linter/invalid-procedure-missing: Cannot find the definition of custom block "{name}"
linter/invalid-procedure-signature: Custom block input information is damaged
linter/invalid-procedure-parameters: Call inputs do not match the definition
linter/invalid-argument-outside: Return block is outside a custom block
linter/invalid-argument-parameter: This input does not belong to the current custom block
linter/invalid-argument-return-type: Call and definition disagree on returning a value
linter/constant-control-condition: This condition is {value, select, true {always true} other {always false}}
linter/constant-control-empty: This control block has no blocks inside
